verdict.rationale: Incremental adoption is a fair axis for a web UI framework, but the evidence never documents embedding Angular in a small part of an existing page and growing it into a full app. The pack instead presents Angular as a fully featured, opinionated platform built around CLI-created workspaces. The 'scale with the size of your team' claim concerns team scaling, not incremental adoption, and the jQuery-integration remark is about legacy AngularJS interop, an adjacent capability.
